rules.title: Use the core functions
rules.text: Use generateText and streamText from the ai package as entry points, with the provider supplied as a model object.

rules.title: Schema-based output
rules.text: Request structured data with Output.object and a schema instead of parsing model text by hand.

rules.title: Typed tools
rules.text: Define tools with tool(), a description, an inputSchema and an execute function so arguments are validated.

rules.title: Bound tool loops
rules.text: Bound multi-step tool loops with stopWhen, for example isStepCount(5). Structured output counts as a step.

rules.title: Handle NoObjectGeneratedError
rules.text: Catch NoObjectGeneratedError and log its text, cause and usage so schema failures can be debugged.

rules.title: Output can throw
rules.text: Read result.output only when the final step finished normally. Otherwise the getter throws NoOutputGeneratedError.

rules.title: Stream partial objects
rules.text: Stream structured data with partialOutputStream and render partial objects progressively.

rules.title: Provider packages
rules.text: Install a provider package such as @ai-sdk/openai instead of calling vendor HTTP APIs directly.

rules.title: Validate fetched URLs
rules.text: When fetching URLs that come from provider responses, set URL validation explicitly and withhold credentials off-origin.

rules.title: Changeset per change
rules.text: In the AI SDK repo, add a patch changeset to every PR that changes published code.
